hook_tournament.why: REPLACING triggers job-loss panic instantly — you stop scrolling in 1.7 seconds flat. DOES or HANDING sound softer and more cryptic, so you're more likely to keep scrolling past a stranger's AI post.

candidates: 6 FULL-TIME BUSINESS JOBS AI NOW DOES OVERNIGHT FOR FREE
ONE TOOL REPLACING 6 FULL-TIME BUSINESS JOBS OVERNIGHT
6 OF YOUR BUSINESS JOBS AI CAN DO WHILE YOU SLEEP
hook_sharpen.why: [0] shocks instantly with 'NOW DOES' and tells the complete story upfront, so you'd swipe to see proof; [1] hides which tool it is, forcing you to swipe to solve a riddle instead of confirming something wild you already believe.
